tests.name: Guest QEMU fixture acceptance after refactor
tests.evidence: Concrete blockers in this sandbox: (1) the acceptance fixture PCM is a local uncommitted input on the user's machine (docs/workstreams/NagiOS_M25_Voice_Workstream.md) and is not available here; using a FLEURS clip as a fixture would turn unseen evaluation data into a fixture; (2) the host is aarch64 (2 shared vCPU), so x86_64 QEMU runs under TCG; the recorded 1.48 s-fixture PASS already took about 37 min under TCG on the reference host, against the fixed 3600 s QEMU timeout in tools/nagi-cli/src/commands.rs (shared, not changeable here); (3) unseen clips are 8-30 s, so a guest unseen-speech run would need several times the fixture's encoder work. Prior guest PASS (run 1790978330938078000) stays a separate, pre-refactor fixture-only record.

do_not_try: Do not count the build-staged fixture PASS as recognition evidence.
Do not raise WHISPER_THREADS or the ADR 0042 memory budget without a new ADR.
Do not use a FLEURS evaluation clip as the guest acceptance fixture.
Do not describe capture-time cancel as production cancellation.
Do not run or ship the placeholder-fixture nagi-init build as an acceptance artifact.

acceptance_criteria: Production provider path contains no fixture input or expected text; fixture check is labelled fixture-only.
Consecutive utterances reuse one context with buffers reset between utterances.
Cancel discards buffered PCM; unload releases the context; reload resumes.

Caller errors (malformed PCM, output too small) fail only that utterance; repeated engine failures release the context until explicit reload; model-read failure during load is reported and retry succeeds.
Accuracy, time, and RAM measured on unseen, openly licensed Japanese speech with license evidence recorded; host and guest results never conflated.
Single-threaded design and ADR 0042 memory budget unchanged.
PCM buffer capacity never exceeds MAX_WHISPER_SAMPLES, including irregular chunk sizes near the limit; cancel/finish retain the zeroed allocation and unload frees it.
Capture-time cancel only is claimed; in-flight inference abort is documented as not implemented.
Scripted same-session tests and real-engine new-session reload checks are labelled and never conflated.
deferred: Real microphone capture, permission, indicator, UI, command routing (other owners).
Multi-threaded inference (requires a worker-pool capability and a new ADR).
Cancellation of in-flight inference (needs whisper.cpp abort_callback in the adapter ABI and a signalling path; outside owned paths/single-thread design).
